title: Animation: Shelves' featured hero cross-fades instead of snapping
description: Cycling the featured hero (LT/RT, or the nav chevrons) in Shelves used to swap art/title/description with zero transition - a real, confirmed gap in the 'Animation + Visual Polish' pass. Fixed with .id(featured.id) + .transition(.opacity) on the hero content plus withAnimation around the state change.
commit_message: Cross-fade Shelves' featured hero on change
